method: Measured municipal building and pavement geometry, photo-guided authored façade details. Reference photographs are not embedded as new textures.

coverage.paving: All 27 Kauppatori Aukiot sections; preserve mapped holes and distinguish asphalt, setts and cobbles.
coverage.market: 34 orange/cream canopies registered to a representative 2025 aerial market layout, filtered against roads, buildings and water. Canopy sizes, counters and produce are approximations.
coverage.shore: 64 short mapped shoreline segments receive low stone quay caps. Bollards are illustrative rather than individually surveyed.
coverage.buildings: Authored market-facing fronts: RATU 216 City Hall, 18 Swedish Embassy, 24 Supreme Court, 23 Presidential Palace main court front; RATU 410 Old Market Hall north/south ends. Palace low wings have arched glazing/balustrades registered to measured wall planes, and its untextured shell has photo-guided plaster/dark roof materials. Municipal roof and courtyard geometry remain in use.
coverage.monuments: HAM/Service Map coordinates for Havis Amanda and Keisarinnankivi. Sculptures are simplified geometric silhouettes, not exact reproductions.

remaining: Not a perfect digital twin: ornaments, sculpture anatomy, material weathering and elevation changes require further validation.
Rear and side elevations mostly retain municipal photographic or untextured source meshes; genuine source texture gaps remain elsewhere in the city.
Old Market Hall long sides retain municipal geometry/photographic materials; only its end façades have this authored replacement.
Allas Sea Pool, ferry vessels, every waterfront shopfront and current vendor inventory are not comprehensively reconstructed by this pass.
